description: A wrapper for making views respond properly to touches on Android. Uses native state drawable for touch feedback. Only supports a single View child. Background drawable can be customized.

basicExample.tsx:
import { TouchableNativeFeedback, View, Text } from 'react-native';

<TouchableNativeFeedback
  onPress={() => alert('Pressed!')}
  background={TouchableNativeFeedback.SelectableBackground()}>
  <View style={{ padding: 20, backgroundColor: '#eee' }}>
    <Text>Press Me</Text>
  </View>
</TouchableNativeFeedback>

usageNotes: Use useForeground for ripple on the foreground (Android 6.0+).
For multiple children, wrap them in a View.
For future-proof touch handling with visual feedback, Pressable is recommended.

background.description: Specifies the type of background drawable for feedback. Use static methods to generate.

useForeground.description: Adds ripple to the foreground instead of background (Android 6.0+).

SelectableBackgroundBorderless.description: Default background for borderless selectable elements (?android:attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless, API 21+).

Ripple.description: Creates a ripple drawable with specified color and options (API 21+).

borderless.description: Ripple can render outside view bounds

canUseNativeForeground.description: Returns boolean indicating if native foreground is supported (Android 6.0+).

notes: Better to use Pressable for cross-platform touch handling.
Supports ripple and selectable background effects using static methods.
